subject: PhD vacancy - Developing IPMs for Black-tailed Godwit Conservation

messages.subject: PhD vacancy - Developing IPMs for Black-tailed Godwit Conservation
parts:
Dear everyone,

The University of Amsterdam (The Netherlands) has a vacancy for a 4-year PhD position, with the focus on further developing IPMs to guide conservation measures for a declining wader species, the Black-tailed Godwit. Please forward it to anyone you know that might be interested! Applying is possible until the 1st of December.

https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/356040/phd-integrated-population-modelling-for-black-tailed-godwit-conservation/

Warm regards,
Marie
